test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Seven friends K, L, M, N, O, P and Q are sitting in a straight line all facing the same direction. N is sitting at one of the corners. O is fourth to the right of Q. Only three persons are sitting between M and L. Q is to the immediate left of P. O is second to the right of K. Only four persons are sitting between N and M. What is L’s position?

options.text: Third to the right of P
Second to the left of P

solution:
**Seven friends: K, L, M, N, O, P and Q**

1) N is sitting at one of the corners.

2) Only four persons are sitting between N and M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1eda026ec9bd062dd42ea7e09c791a9c363ba0c3118844fe4ac8b9dde1d47fb.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f31c3e330fd73caf93ef4e6d35eb36ba364c289bd2cac797588b4853cb1144ce.png] 

3) Only three persons are sitting between M and L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1b8fd085ddc1b61d456f95a9a79640fd6b7283470edafb4d06a132d31258e1d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc9e1d6692e69935b47b1dd484f1effd9f918cbcfb23cdecf416af0dc3e805ae.png] 

4) O is fourth to the right of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da9cf26ae7542d80dde8402108f511bd0d668abf6e0445990188c130b54967ab.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75394b7f6f4729a1d456ec2f72094390dc5adb972eee7a819e083cb0ff018ae3.png] 

5) Q is immediate left of P.

(It means case 2 is eliminated because there is no place left of P to sit immediate of Q in Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dccf8ab4f41ff0b9cb361d442a3d5a2f597a5a733000b8b2035da6890d162eca.png] 

6) Only one place are left and K is sit on that place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bda5d6134b9fc1c663169e335e885c576a49d41b77e7fc0e5a97b6c28043e8b6.png] 

Clearly, we can see that L sit second to the left of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Second to the left of P".**
